newsitem.title: USA: Hamburger Hamlet asset sale off, CEO out.
newsitem.headline: Hamburger Hamlet asset sale off, CEO out.

text.p: Hamburger Hamlet Restaurants Inc said Tuesday after the market closed that its agreement to sell operating assets to Grill Concepts Inc was terminated and that its chief executive officer and president, Shawn Holder, resigned.
Hamburger Hamlet said the restaurants, which generate positive cash flow from operations, will continue to operate in Chapter 11 with the support of the company's major secured creditor.
The company said that its agreement was terminated due to Grill Concept's inability to obtain the financing.
Richard Matthews, current chairman of the board, was named CEO and and president, the company said.
Holder, who resigned to pursue other opportunities, will remain a director and a consultant to the company, it said.
